name: Mount Dalt
title: Mount Dalt
summary: Middle mountain of the Mount Alphus range, with portals to Mount Gemm and Mount Syliph (acpedia). In the kit: a flat summit plateau (~120 x 135 m) at z 224 with 60-65 degree flanks to the plain at 108-120; the North Syliph portal stands on the south-west rim and the South Gemm portal on the north-east rim; Mount Gemm rises 500 m north-east.

landmarks.name: South Gemm portal
landmarks.note: Portal swirl on the north-east rim.

landmarks.name: North Syliph portal
landmarks.note: Portal swirl on the south-west rim.

site.name: Mount Dalt
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer north-dalt (summit plateau, north-east corner by the South Gemm portal). [critic b4-7 2026-10-15: teleport changed from '@teleloc 0x8F91003E 188.9 138 224 -0.333807 0 0 -0.942642' because the gazetteer north-dalt drop was 3.0 m from the South Gemm portal (weenieType Portal) on the summit rim. Derived drop 12 m south-west on flat summit ground (224.0, level within 1 m for 12 m around), 14.6 m from the portal, 13 m from any drawn object. Cell index = floor(lx/24)*8+floor(ly/24)+1, z = ground + 0.5.]

shots.standingOrder: Fly north-east 28 m over the flat summit of Mount Dalt with the gimbal fixed, the rim and the pillar of Mount Gemm rising ahead; stay 25 m above the plateau, patrolling tumeroks may be faded.
shots.notes: Travelling vista across the summit of Mount Dalt, gimbal fixed at -18 degrees, the plateau rim ahead and the pillar of Mount Gemm rising beyond it. No subject (flyover vista). Verified (check.mjs, full take flown): take 0-10 s: AGL 28..28 m, nearest drawn 47.76 m (spawn South Gemm), vmax 7 m/s; edit 2-8.5 s: AGL 28..28 m, nearest drawn 56.94 m (spawn South Gemm), vmax 7 m/s; flight cinema peak 7.02 m/s (cap 12), max tracking gap 0.03 m.

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up from 10 m over the South Gemm portal swirl on the north-east rim of Mount Dalt to 62 m, turning 20 degrees, until the summit plateau and the drop beyond its rim fill the frame; nothing above the summit within 50 m.
shots.notes: Top-down rise over the South Gemm portal swirl on the north-east rim of Mount Dalt (pitch -88 for the portal particles): from 10 m to 62 m the swirl shrinks and the flat summit plateau and the drop beyond its rim open around it.
